versions.subject: rule: whoami as local system
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|contains: '\whoami.exe'
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM' 
condition: selection

versions.subject: fix: SCCM false positives with whoami.exe rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|contains: '\whoami.exe'
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
filter1:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\monitoringhost.exe'  # SCCM False Positives
condition: selection and not filter1
